patterns.note: Alternating two-column layouts for feature sections, with text on one side and a visual element (image, video, or icon cluster) on the other, within full-width content bands.
A vibrant teal (#05b7bf) is used as a strong brand accent for the hero background and footer, contrasting with predominantly white and light grey content sections.
The header navigation bar transforms upon scroll, changing from a transparent background with white text/logo to a solid white background with dark text/logo, and slightly reducing in height.
A prominent, terminal-like code block is integrated directly into the hero section, providing quick-start instructions and immediately conveying the technical nature of the product.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is built to be sticky, using CSS transitions to smoothly change its background color, text color, and potentially its height as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

Content sections are structured with full-width containers that house a fixed-width inner container for text and visual elements, often employing a flexbox or grid layout for side-by-side content presentation.

The hero section features a styled code block, mimicking a terminal window with syntax highlighting, to display command-line instructions. This is likely achieved with a preformatted text element styled with specific background, border, and font properties, and potentially using a JavaScript library for highlighting.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with standard body text and smaller, sometimes uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners for buttons and cards, sharp corners for code blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced vertical spacing between sections; the hero section is airy, while feature grids maintain a comfortable density.

standout: The most distinctive element is the prominent, terminal-style code block embedded directly in the hero section, which immediately communicates the product's technical nature and offers an actionable quick-start guide. This, combined with the vibrant teal branding, creates a memorable first impression for a developer-focused tool.
